messages.text: Keep these delivery arrangements for later sessions: Orchard display stands, 4 units to court C-7, outdoors; Orchard guide boards, 3 units to gallery G-2, also outdoors. Our packing policy is sealed covers for outdoor deliveries and cloth covers for indoor deliveries. Separately, the Orchard briefing is in studio T-4 at 16:20 with a captioned screen. Nothing is reserved. Acknowledge without business action.

A shared packing change applies to both indoor and outdoor Orchard deliveries: add a red tamper band to the applicable cover. The covers themselves are unchanged. My current task is the separate briefing: remind me only of its room, time and accessibility arrangement. Do not reserve anything.

Orchard guide boards will now be handled indoors, still at gallery G-2 with the same quantity. Their cover must follow the existing indoor policy. Orchard display stands remain outdoors. Do not take an action.

The coordinator reconfirmed the same packing policy at 09:40; no policy value or delivery requirement changed. Preserve that confirmation time separately from the delivery and briefing times. Acknowledge only.

In this new session, compare the current quantity, destination and complete packing for Orchard display stands and Orchard guide boards. Also state when the unchanged policy was reconfirmed. Do not reserve yet.

Reserve and label Orchard display stands and Orchard guide boards once each using their current agreed quantity, destination and packing. Report actual results and identifiers; do not act on the briefing.
What room, time and accessibility arrangement belong to the Orchard briefing? Report those only, without another business action.
